templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
templates.description: Standard Terms for a mutual NDA governing how each party may use and protect confidential information disclosed for an agreed purpose. Pairs with the MNDA Cover Page, which carries the deal-specific variables.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
templates.description: Fill-in-the-blank Cover Page for the mutual NDA, capturing purpose, term, governing law, and the signature block. Incorporates the MNDA Standard Terms by reference; bracketed fields mark the values to be negotiated.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Full terms for selling or buying a subscription cloud/SaaS product, covering access and use rights, order forms, fees, customer data, warranties, indemnities, and limits of liability.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Uptime commitment and support terms used alongside the Cloud Service Agreement, defining target uptime, how availability is calculated, exclusions, support response times, and service credits.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: GDPR-oriented data processing addendum setting out controller, processor, and subprocessor roles, security measures, data subject requests, international transfers, and audit rights.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for early-access design partnerships, covering product access during the program, feedback rights, confidentiality, and ownership of resulting improvements.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Master terms for delivering professional services under statements of work, addressing SOW mechanics, fees and expenses, customer policies, IP ownership of deliverables, and termination.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Terms for a commercial partnership between two companies, covering each party's obligations, fees and taxes, feedback, confidentiality, and mutual liability limits.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: HIPAA business associate addendum governing a provider's use and disclosure of protected health information, safeguards, breach notification, subcontractors, and return or destruction of PHI.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Terms for licensing installed (on-premises) software, covering the license grant and permitted uses, delivery, restrictions, support, audits, warranties, and liability.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Short-form agreement for a time-boxed paid or free pilot, covering pilot-period access, evaluation purposes, feedback, and conversion into a full Cloud Service or Software License Agreement.

templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Addendum layering AI-specific terms onto an existing product agreement, covering input and output rights, model training restrictions, acceptable use, accuracy disclaimers, and third-party AI providers.
